_about: Round 10 (2026-11-25): the volume changes are what sounds rough (Anthony on round 9: 'audio leveling is bad, its not smooth. but i like the same instruments'). All tiles are one continuous piece with the same instruments; only how the volume is handled differs. Earlier rounds are in variants_round*.json.

variants.label: One piece, same instruments (the one you scored 3)
variants.why: For reference. The volume steps between sections and dips sharply before each big moment.

variants.label: No dips before big moments
variants.why: The sudden drop-outs and bumps around the big moments are removed. The volume still rises and falls by section.

variants.label: No dips, and only small volume changes
variants.why: Quiet sections are only slightly quieter than loud ones, and the volume glides over two seconds.

variants.label: Volume left exactly as the music model played it
variants.why: No volume changes are added at all. The rise and fall comes only from how the music itself is written.

variants.label: Volume evened out
variants.why: No added volume changes, and the music's own loud and quiet stretches are pulled closer together.
